entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Yeah, great. Another recording. Just get me a person already!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this helmet I bought. I expect a full refund, and I don't want any hassle.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF-60771. Look, let's just cut to it. I'm sending it back. The box is unopened. Just send me the label.
I have your order right here, Mark. I see the Trail Helmet. So I can document this correctly for you, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

Are you listening to me? It's none of your business! The color is hideous, not what it looked like online. I'm not trusting my safety to a product from a company that can't even get pictures right. If you can't process this return right now, I want to speak to your manager. I'm two seconds from blasting VeloFit all over the internet.

I understand your frustration with the color, Mark, and I can definitely handle this for you. No need for a manager. Let me just confirm the return eligibility. I see the item was delivered 66 days ago.
And? So what? It's brand new.
No problem at all. According to our policy, you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for a full refund. I can approve this for you right now.
Oh. You can? Just like that?

Yes, sir. I've just initiated the return. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Huh. Okay, well... that was easier than I thought it would be. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly.
You're very welcome, Mark. We want to make it right. Will there be anything else for you today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
